user.title: Configure AUPU Q360
user.description: All values are validated locally. WSS is disabled by default and this step does not contact AUPU. The JWT persists across HA restarts but is never refreshed automatically.

confirm_wss.title: Confirm read-only connection check
confirm_wss.description: Submitting this page authorizes exactly one read-only terminal-info request. It does not send a device control command.

reauth_manual_token.title: Reauthenticate AUPU
reauth_manual_token.description: Enter a new valid Bearer JWT. The current token is never displayed.

reauth_method.title: Reauthenticate AUPU
reauth_method.description: Choose SMS recovery or a manual Token. Your current token is never displayed.

reauth_sms_send.title: Send verification code
reauth_sms_send.description: Submitting sends one SMS verification code. Sending is limited to once per 60 seconds, and the number is only saved when selected.

reauth_sms_code.title: Enter verification code
reauth_sms_code.description: Enter the six-digit SMS verification code. It expires locally after five minutes and is never saved.

error.invalid_signer: The signer JSON is incomplete or invalid.
error.invalid_device: The device identifier or tag is invalid.
error.cannot_connect: The connection or authentication request failed. No configuration was saved.
error.cannot_send_sms: The verification code could not be sent. No configuration was saved.
error.sms_rate_limited: A verification code was sent recently. Please wait before sending another.
error.sms_code_expired: The verification code has expired. Request a new code.

abort.invalid_state: The pending configuration is no longer available.

init.title: Update local credentials
init.description: Leave the token blank to keep the existing token. Changes are saved only after the complete candidate is valid.

confirm_wss.title: Confirm read-only connection check
confirm_wss.description: Submitting this page authorizes exactly one read-only terminal-info request. Existing settings remain unchanged if it fails.

error.invalid_phone: The phone number must contain exactly 11 ASCII digits.
error.cannot_connect: The read-only connection check failed. Existing settings were not changed.

abort.invalid_state: The pending update is no longer available.

jwt_expiring.title: AUPU token expires soon
jwt_expiring.description: The local AUPU token expires within 24 hours. Before expiry, use the integration Options to enter a new Token manually. This warning does not start an SMS reauthentication flow.

jwt_expired.title: AUPU token expired
jwt_expired.description: The local AUPU token has expired. Use SMS reauthentication or enter a manual Token before controlling the light.
